source_text: While isolated observational studies have suggested possible localized increases in partner numbers among newly circumcised youth, these lack causal controls and are outweighed by RCT evidence; critics' emphasis on hypothetical compensation has not been substantiated empirically, with modeling indicating that even moderate risk increases would erode observed HIV reductions, which persist in population data. [114]
